title: When the Confession Burns
author: Isandro Dunmore
blurb: Juniper Hartwell, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
